# otel-span-lint

> Lint OpenTelemetry spans from OTLP JSON against a bundled table of HTTP semantic conventions v1.26.0: required, deprecated and malformed attributes Python package `trysac-otel-span-lint`, import name `otel_span_lint`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
